xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013172025-11-2620-55-08" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex013172025-11-2620-55-18">de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs></note> sdom pa'i sbyor ba sems bskyed bsam pa'i mtshan <pb n="3b"/><lb n="3b1"/> gzhir mi 'thad pa dang byang chub 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid ma khyab pa dang sdom pa sems bskyed du rtsi na <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3742">bslab btus</rs> las seMs bskyed dang skye ba'i rten lan gnyis dpyad pa mi 'thad <lb n="3b2"/> pas 'di gnyis kyi khyad par dpe don ni <note type="gloss">spangs rtogs kyi byang chub la yid smon tsaM dang dngos su zhugs pa</note> <abbr>'jig rten</abbr> pa dang <abbr>'jig rten</abbr> las 'das pa'i sems bskyed yin no zhe'o <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs></note> |</seg></TEI>
